boundary.presentationOwner: SDK/pinned ILCompiler invokes the adapter with one explicit root and an exact versioned available-body manifest.
boundary.semanticAdmissionOwner: RestrictedCilImporterV1 AdapterPresented mode validates the body world and owns method identity, exact direct-call admission, deterministic graph order and SCC rejection.
boundary.backendOwner: Every admitted method follows the existing CIL -> Canonical/Core -> scheduling -> allocation -> one HCO per method -> static linker -> restricted HCEXE path.

contracts.entryContract: static parameterless System.Void or System.Int32 only

implementation.bodyWorldTransport: A canonical SHA-256-bound presentation manifest is passed through the pinned ILCompiler process environment to its adapter subprocess; the temporary manifest is removed after the process exits.
implementation.manifestValidation: Exact schema/version/profile/PE hash/root, canonical unique sorted bodies, root membership and contract digest are validated before import.
implementation.graphCompilation: AdapterPresented body world feeds the Phase 02 graph and Phase 04 object linker; graph/object/backend digests and method count are projected into image and publish provenance.
implementation.sdkSelection: HybridCpuProfile=HybridCPU.DotNetAot.ScalarControlFlowV2 and an explicit HybridCpuPresentedMethods list are required; legacy projects omit the option and keep their original route.
implementation.constantCallArgumentCorrection: A prerequisite execution gap found by the Phase 05 ISE test was closed in the common CIL lowering: constant managed-call arguments now materialize as ADDI x0, immediate instead of selecting a trailing zero immediate.

cleanPublishEvidence.cleanProcedure: Adapter/Core/CIL Release outputs cleaned, exact projects restored, two fresh immutable packs installed from the pinned ILCompiler/reference inputs, sample cleaned/restored, then two dotnet publish -c Release -r hybridcpu runs compared.

executionEvidence.path: C# -> Release CIL -> pinned ILCompiler -> adapter-presented body world -> Canonical/Core -> HCO/link/HCEXE -> existing ISE decode/execute/memory/writeback
executionEvidence.program: parameterless root -> loop helper plus two callers sharing one leaf
executionEvidence.authority: ISE retained execution/fault/retire authority; compiler image and publish provenance retain all runtime/publication authority flags false.

negativeEvidence: missing explicit ScalarControlFlowV2 body world HCPUB1112

releaseDisposition.runtimeBehaviorClaim: The exact restricted ScalarControlFlowV2 sample is clean-publishable through pinned ILCompiler and executes its five-method acyclic loop/call graph correctly on ISE.

externalBaselineFailures: global.json requests SDK 10.0.201; local deterministic roll-forward resolves SDK 10.0.204 as frozen in Phase 00.
The CIL Release build and ISE Release build retain their pre-existing warning inventories.
Pinned ILCompiler and runtime reference inputs were reused from the previously qualified immutable local Phase 26 pack; the adapter/compiler pack itself was cleaned and rebuilt twice.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Qualify the full source-to-ISE release corpus, compiler/ISE fingerprints, stale-fact properties, loader/ABI parity, exact provenance and final language support matrix without default enablement.
